models_015:
LingWrite goes through no server; it connects to providers directly with your key.

The writing model handles actions you start, like continuing or rewriting. The background model handles post-chapter summaries, consistency checks and foreshadowing tips, so you can pick a cheaper one.

Most providers’ “subscription plans” only allow use in coding tools; using them in a writing app may get your key banned. Use a pay-as-you-go API by default.
